title: 节日与习俗词汇
goal: 辨认节日词汇，区分庆祝活动及其象征意义。

points.label: 选择保留活动与象征意义的表达

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 节俗描写包括时间、活动、参加者与象征意义。活动说明人们做了什么，象征意义说明人们赋予事物的含义。

body.box:
原文：一些家庭在中秋节团聚，圆月象征团圆。
译文：Some families gather at the Mid-Autumn Festival; the full moon symbolizes reunion.

body.p: gather 是活动，symbolizes reunion 是寓意。some families 保留习俗的适用范围。

body.box:
原文：中秋节时，一些家庭团聚赏月。圆月在这一习俗中象征团圆，家庭的庆祝方式也有差异。
译文：At the Mid-Autumn Festival, some families gather to admire the moon. In this custom, the full moon symbolizes reunion, and families celebrate in different ways.

body.p: gather to admire the moon 表示团聚赏月，symbolizes reunion 表示圆月的寓意。some 和 different ways 保留范围与差异。

groups.fill: A community centre is planning an autumn celebration in its only hall, with a meal, lanterns and music. Local fami{lies} will gat{her} for festi{vities} and deco{rate} the ha{ll} with lant{erns} while sha{ring} seasonal fo{od} and gree{tings} before perfor{mances}. Volunteers will place the lights near the entrance, and a local music group will play after the meal. Guests can also see drawings made by children. Some drawings show a good harvest, while others express wishes for the coming year. The event offers neighbours a chance to spend time together.
notes: hall：灯笼用于装饰唯一的大厅。
performances：音乐表演安排在用餐之后。

groups.text:
At one community's spring celebration, neighbours meet in a public garden. Some bring handmade decorations, while others prepare food to share. A local music group performs during the meal. At the end of the afternoon, children give paper flowers to older relatives. For these families, the flowers express wishes for health.

The organisers describe the event as a chance for neighbours to spend time together. They do not require everyone to bring a decoration or take part in the performance. Families may attend for the whole afternoon or visit briefly. The garden gathering is one local way of welcoming the season, and the meanings attached to the flowers are explained by the participating families.

items.stem: 中文信息：有些邻居带手工装饰品，另一些准备食物。Which statement preserves this distinction?
options: Some neighbours bring decorations, while others prepare food.
All neighbours bring decorations and prepare food together.
Some neighbours bring decorations, while others perform music.
Some neighbours bring food, while the children bring paper flowers.
items.why: Some bring handmade decorations, while others prepare food 区分两组活动。

items.stem: What does the word gathering refer to?
options: The display of handmade decorations in a home
The meeting of neighbours in the public garden
The preparation of food by the music group
The giving of paper flowers to older relatives
items.why: neighbours meet in a public garden 说明 gathering 指邻居在花园相聚。

items.stem: 中文信息：对这些家庭而言，纸花表达健康的祝愿。Which statement conveys this meaning?
options: The flowers express the organisers' wishes for health.
The flowers express the families' wishes for the new season.
The flowers express the families' wishes for health.
The flowers express the children's thanks to older relatives.
items.why: For these families, the flowers express wishes for health 对应纸花的寓意。

items.stem: What is the function of the local music group?
options: To explain the meaning of the paper flowers
To invite all families to bring decorations
To prepare the food before the neighbours arrive
To give a performance during the shared meal
items.why: A local music group performs during the meal 说明乐队在用餐期间表演。

items.stem: 中文信息：家庭可以参加整个下午，也可以短暂来访。Which statement preserves the choice?
options: Families can stay all afternoon or pay a short visit.
Families must stay all afternoon to receive flowers.
Families can visit briefly only if they bring food.
Families can stay all afternoon but must bring a decoration.
items.why: Families may attend for the whole afternoon or visit briefly 表示两种选择。

groups.fill: For a winter celebration, each family plans dinner, expects several relatives and exchanges good wishes. Each hous{ehold} will pre{pare} a din{ner} and wel{come} their rela{tives} with gree{tings} before sha{ring} traditional fo{od} and wis{hes} during celebr{ations}. The people taking part may choose dishes that are familiar to their own families. Some also decorate their homes with paper stars. For them the stars represent hope for the coming year. Other families mark the occasion in different ways, and the customs can change over time as relatives live in different places.

groups.text:
A town holds a community celebration at the beginning of the harvest season. On the day of the event, volunteers decorate a shared hall with paper leaves. Some households bring food made from local produce, and neighbours meet to share a meal. A group of musicians performs after the meal, while visitors can look at pictures of earlier celebrations.

In the hall, residents make a large paper tree that carries their written messages. Some messages express thanks for the harvest; others contain wishes for the coming year. For the people who make it, the tree represents the connections among neighbours. The tree is a symbol in this particular celebration, not an object that every household is required to display.

The organisers invite both long-time residents and newcomers. People may write a message, enjoy the music, or simply visit the hall. A short exhibition also explains how the event has changed. Earlier celebrations were smaller and took place outdoors, but the aim of bringing neighbours together has remained. The exhibition records these changes without suggesting that every family celebrates in the same way.

items.stem: 中文信息：一些家庭带当地农产品制成的食物。Which statement preserves the scope?
options: Every household must bring food grown in the town.
Some households bring food made from local produce.
Some households bring paper leaves to decorate the hall.
All long-time residents bring food made from local produce.
items.why: Some households bring food made from local produce 限定为一些家庭。

items.stem: What does the paper tree represent for its makers?
options: The dates of earlier outdoor celebrations
The music played after the shared meal
The relationships among their neighbours
The different foods made from local produce
items.why: the tree represents the connections among neighbours 说明纸树的象征意义。

items.stem: 中文信息：有些留言表达感谢，另一些写下新年愿望。Which statement preserves both meanings?
options: All messages give thanks for the harvest.
Some messages give thanks, while others describe earlier celebrations.
Some messages express wishes, while others thank the musicians.
Some messages give thanks, while others express wishes.
items.why: Some messages express thanks 和 others contain wishes 分别对应感谢与愿望。

items.stem: What does the exhibition record about the celebration?
options: Changes in its setting and size over time
A rule requiring every family to display a tree
A change from shared meals to music alone
A move from indoor to outdoor celebrations
items.why: Earlier celebrations were smaller and took place outdoors 说明规模和地点的变化。

items.stem: 中文信息：纸树代表制作者心中的邻里联系。Which statement keeps the activity separate from its meaning?
options: Every household displays a tree to fulfil a town rule.
Residents make a tree that represents their connections.
Residents make a tree that records the dates of earlier celebrations.
Residents make a tree that represents thanks for the harvest.
items.why: 居民制作纸树，树对制作者而言代表邻里联系。
